build_sparse_voxel_map: build a SparseVoxelMapAgent to collect RGB, depth, and pose data for 3D spatial-semantic mapping
run_main_runner: run the main_runner function to build a SparseVoxelMap for a ScanNet scene and evaluate object detection
step_observation: step a single observation into the voxel map agent to add RGB, depth, and instance data
query_instances_for_text: query the voxel map for instances matching a text query using class_match or text_image_encoder method
build_scene_from_observations: build a scene from a list of observations and retrieve instances for multiple text queries
